## Welcome

The Doctoral Urban Planning seminar is a platform for the intellectual development of PhD students in the Department of Urban & Regional Planning. The seminar provides a shared space for students to present their research and to solicit critical, yet constructive, peer reviews and advice.

## The Seminar Cycle

The seminar is built around a **four-semester cycle** of workshops. Students cycle through all four phases during their pre-candidacy coursework.

| Phase | Focus | When |
|-------|-------|------|
| **Phase 1** | Writing Your First Article | Fall |
| **Phase 2** | Writing for Funding | Fall (alternating) |
| **Phase 3** | Writing Your Dissertation Proposal | Spring |
| **Phase 4** | Developing Your Academic Brand | Spring (alternating) |

::: {.callout-note}
## Current Semester: Fall 2026

This semester focuses on **Writing Your First Article** — developing publishable scholarship from coursework and early research.
:::

## This Semester at a Glance

**Fall 2026: Writing Your First Article**

- 5 core workshops on article writing, journal targeting, argumentation, peer review, and co-authorship
- 5 rounds of peer presentations — informal, low-stakes research-in-progress talks
- ACSP conference prep in Week 8
- Annual CV check-in built into Week 1

**Spring 2027: Writing Your Dissertation Proposal**

- 5 core workshops on proposal structure, theoretical frameworks, methods, timelines, and defense strategies
- Milestone presentations — Plan of Study, updated plans, and QRP/Exam content
- ICUA/UAA conference prep in Week 13
